//: Copy to config.json in the run's e2e/ and fill it. Keys starting with // are comments. A value starting with FILL makes `node runner.mjs check` fail: fill it or remove the key. No secrets here: the service's record and the owner's session live in state/, which never leaves the run folder. The origin is not here: each segment's service gets a free port, which state/service.json names.
//run: The pass id; the runner's --run overrides it. Partitions manifest.<run>.jsonl and screens/<run>/.
//checkWorld: The world `node runner.mjs check` starts a service on. The worlds are packages/docket/tests/ui_world.py's: empty, week, meetings, today, stale, search, recording, briefs, staging, curate.
//browser: The machine's own Chrome, headless, in a profile of Playwright's own, as devkit ui and the browser tests drive it: nothing is downloaded, and the owner's browser is never touched. msedge works too.

captureGrid.//viewports: Desktop first, but devkit ui shoots every page at 1440x900 and 390x844, so the phone is in every page's grid; 1280 is the narrowest width with the sidebar, the list and the 480 px panel side by side (DR-0708). touch: true shoots the cell in a fresh context with a real coarse pointer (isMobile, hasTouch) and holds it to the 44 px target floor.
captureGrid.//extraViewports: Opt-in cells, shot only when a step names them. short: the Environment lens's short viewport, shoot(state, { viewports: ['short'] }), named 1280x600. fold: the sidebar folded to icons. tablet: from 768 to 1023 px the sidebar is a sheet and the panel slides over the list, where the notice's Undo once hid under the panel.

//judgedCombos: The canonical cell a judge reads per state. Other cells reach a judge only as pixel deltas or through the sweeps.
//clockEpoch: Date.now() is fixed here so relative times and baselines are stable: devkit ui's clock, a Tuesday 09:30 in the invented week, in Europe/Budapest.
//themePref: capture() sets the theme cookie and the document's data-theme to follow the system before the grid, so the emulated colour scheme drives the theme, and restores both after.
//authedAssert: The signed-in shell renders the sidebar; a stranger gets the 401 sign-in page instead, which is never shot as the target.

personas.//: Docket has one owner. The runner signs the owner in at the start of each segment, through a one-time link on localhost; a stranger has no session.

//maskRegions: Selectors painted a flat colour before every shot, so live values never move a baseline. The clock is fixed, so usually none are needed.
//overlaySelector: What an open overlay looks like, as Radix marks it: capture() shoots it in place and never reloads under it.
//textSelectors: Extra places a page shows errors and status, merged over the defaults in lib/capture.mjs: role alert (a refusal, the writer's words), role status (a write's notice), aria-invalid.
//axeTags: devkit ui's and browser_kit's rule set: a cell this passes, they pass.
//bannedText: Regexes for words a page must never show. Regenerate per run from what the text of record bans rather than keep a copy that drifts.
//coarseProbe: { selector, minPx }: a control styled per pointer; touch cells must render it at least minPx tall, proving the coarse pointer rendered. A row is 32 px on a fine pointer and 44 on a coarse one (DR-0707).

networkBudget.//: expectStatus: { "<url regex>": [400, 409] } for statuses that are designed; a step's expectedStatuses adds to it. foreignAllow stays empty: nothing loads from another origin.

//pixelThreshold: pixelmatch 8: how different two colours must be for a pixel to count as changed, 0 to 1, measured in OKLab with the HyAB distance, where 1 is black against white. Per pixel, not a share of the image.
//pixelDiffRatioMax: The ratio rule, used while pixelWindowSize is null: a cell changed when the share of differing pixels exceeds this. 0: any differing pixel.
//pixelWindowSize: The window rule, off while null. With N set, a cell changed when the most differing pixels in any N x N square exceed pixelWindowMax. Turn it on only when clean cells keep showing noise deltas, and keep the max below what one changed character makes at DPR 1.
//batteryValues: Valid values per field role for the battery's fix probe.
//runner: serviceStartS: how long a world may take to build and its service to start; the indexed worlds take longest.
